title: Pick several strikes, see the count, Clear All and Done (G-19-1)
reference_behaviour: The leg picker keeps a running selection: a footer reads how many legs are selected, with Clear All and Done; Done adds every selected contract to the builder at once.
ours: Today's picker adds one leg per Add press through selects. REQ-080 AC-3 (several contracts, Done adds all) is not built.
